mapper.sql: id, user_id, code, `day`, amount, fee, principal, total
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO `asset_series` (user_id, code, `day`, amount, fee, principal, total) VALUES
(#{row.userId}, #{row.code}, #{row.day}, #{row.amount}, #{row.fee}, #{row.principal}, #{row.total})
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = incoming.amount, fee = incoming.fee, principal = incoming.principal, total = incoming.total
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, s.code, s.`day`, s.amount, s.fee, s.principal, s.total FROM `asset_series` s JOIN (SELECT code, MAX(`day`) AS max_day FROM `asset_series` WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY code) m ON m.code = s.code AND m.max_day = s.`day` WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
